description: This PHP class 'FilterParams' defines a data transfer object used for managing filtering parameters in the OrangeHRM system, including sorting order, sort field, limit, and offset, with validation for the sort order.

classes.name: FilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating filtering parameters such as sort order, sort field, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sorting order (ascending or descending).

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order after validating its value ('ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING').

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the field to sort by.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the field to sort by, can be null.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items to retrieve.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit for items to retrieve.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the offset from the beginning of the list.
